media.title: Skinner Shaping Pigeon Turn Clip

timecodes.what: At kf_004.jpg (16.5s) (4:3 camera frame), XXPorcelinaX's recording states "Suppose I shape up the behavior of making a complete turn. What I do is simply as I did then, to wait for some part of that behavior." — providing spoken context for pigeon spinning counterclockwise before the 15-second grain hopper.

Mid-segment 4:3 camera frame at kf_007.jpg (33.0s) as narration explains "All you can see is the effect is instantaneous. I'm waiting for it to turn counterclockwise now, and then I reinforce that movement,", clarifying key empirical findings in B. F. Skinner's fixed-time non-contingent hopper delivery experiment ('Superstition in the Pigeon').

Around kf_009.jpg (44.0s) (4:3 camera frame), commentary states "and then I reinforce that movement, and I wait for a more pronounced...", connecting the empirical results to broader cognitive and neural science.
